findings: EffectExecutorRegistry capture freezes completed child-instruction entry facts before later composite effects. Existing captured snapshots must not refresh at outer boundaries.

PendingEntryCommitter delegates executors directly, so resumed direct entries bypass the registry. Capture after the complete collection/single entry, before the graveyard-copy exile rider and before outer continuation resumes.

Donor original11 tests reference new entrySnapshot API; compiling those against unmodified baseline would only produce a compile failure, not valid negative evidence. Add baseline-compilable event-matcher controls separately, preserve original11 bytes.

New control candidates: token then pump; preexisting anthem then later pump; serialized event with absent entrant; paused copy+printed choice followed by outer pump (serialized and live); immediate entry and simultaneous token static/counter groups as passing baseline controls.

Current EntitySnapshot.fromProjection has evolved since donor and includes grantedStaticAbilities. Review face-down/sensitive-data retention explicitly; do not claim absence of scripts solely from donor comment.
Snapshot lookup for unknown card predicates is tri-state; check every presently supported entry predicate and state/controller predicate. Donor entry snapshot is not full observer-time capture.

Direct spell/played-land/initializer and other paused producers remain separate. Existing entryTriggersAlreadyProcessed field prevents exact-event duplicate detection, not generic event-time snapshot qualification.

Exact Metamorph original10 test bytes remain preserved. Token intrinsic abilities and face-down copiable values are not fully carried by current CardComponent-only copy paths; do not claim card semantic readiness from ordinary object-copy tests.

StatePredicate entry arms still read eventual counters, face-up/down, attachments, combat and comparative power. Donor card-characteristic snapshots alone do not freeze those predicates. Keep scope explicit and add targeted state-predicate capture/controls before full-entry admission.

TriggerDetector later suppression/duplication and intervening-if filtering use the supplied current state. Entrant characteristic snapshot is not an observer-set snapshot; Torpor Orb/Panharmonicon or observers entering/leaving during later instructions need separate entry-time qualification.

Current MoveCollectionExecutor applies EntersWithReplacements.applyOnEntry after each individual move; applyGlobal enumerates the then-current battlefield. entryBoundary currently governs tapped/untapped projection but is not passed to counter replacements. Coentrant global-counter sources may incorrectly affect later entrants: a concrete candidate for a preregistered simultaneous-counter regression, not yet tested.

PendingEntryCopyContinuation and PendingEntryChoiceContinuation are absent from ObjectReferencePropagation's objectReferences/withObjectReferences arms. Their context is serialized, but registry authorization of primary moves may not reach outer Self/triggering references. PipelineTarget reads late-bound collection IDs separately. This requires targeted source-reference continuation tests; do not conflate it with the proposed entrant snapshot controls.
